title: 页码
description: Insert toolbar on a layout or master surface: 页码 adds a page-number text field ({page}), which each page shows with its own number. The button is hidden on page mode.

kimiUi.appearsWhen: on a layout or master surface

preconditions.notes: Entered first with 编辑版式 on page 5 (正文).

steps: 在版式编辑时点击插入工具栏「页码」

pptd.summary: insertPageNumber adds a text element with field pageNumber to the layout

selfTestChecklist: a layout surface shows the 页码 insert
完成 leaves the layout, and 页码 inserts the page number
